notes.title: Update notes for 06 April
notes.notes:
- Switched to better graphics engine (HDRP).
- Slightly different environment options ([b]ESC menu→Environment[/b]).
- Choice between low, med, high graphics quality ([b]ESC menu→Environment[/b]).
- Track is seen through terrain while in track-laying mode.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yfb3Vj3wet8

notes.title: New graphic effects. Improved track.
notes.notes:
Latest build includes ability to apply visual effects - day/night, position of the sun, fog + "vintage filter".
Plus new improved track - additional wide curves. Also, basic terrain edition - flattening + hills/valleys.

notes.title: LOCO Railroad: It's time to play
notes.notes: Update that brings actual gameplay: create own layout, lay track, place buildings, select wagons, run train.
